_what_this_is: The assistant's model runtime is not shipped in the image: the llama.cpp server binary and the GGUF model are downloaded to /data/assistant when an admin enables the assistant, and every download is verified against the SHA-256 pinned here. The pins are facts about files the pin-assistant-sources workflow fetched and hashed on a runner; a null sha256 means the artifact has not been pinned yet and the download refuses to run.
